name: print-social-blue-problem-solution-carousel-with-numbered-values
title: Six-slide blue and white problem–solution carousel with icon pills and numbered value tiles
whatItIs: Six portrait slides alternating navy and pale blue: 'Meet the platform!' with white icon pills, 'Our Vision' with circles, 'The Problem' with list cards, 'Built on Principles' with numbered 01/02/03 tiles, 'What Drives Us?' with blue bar buttons and 'The Sample Approach' showing mini slide previews.
whatItMeans: Organised and trustworthy; the consistent header and alternating tones make a pitch feel like a tidy deck.
techniques: Alternate dark and light slides for rhythm.
Underline and colour one word in each headline.
Use big numbered tiles for values.
Show thumbnails of your own slides as the proof slide.

vocabulary.definition: A carousel laid out like presentation slides.
A block showing a large index number.
